title: S01 Right-Angle Pavement and Curb
description: Original single closed 1.2 m square, 0.15 m high pavement corner with a continuous 0.15 m wide south/east curb band. West port X=-0.6 and north port Y=+0.6 join unchanged transport-curb-straight-01 or transport-curb-ramp-01. At identity, neighbours are centred (-1.6,0,0) with Z rotation 0 degrees and (0,1.6,0) with Z rotation +90 degrees. Rotate all placements together in 90-degree steps. Origin is footprint centre at ground Z=0. The old pieces retain their own 2 m pitch. One editable original mesh, two exact existing mineral PBR materials; no overlay or overlapping straight pieces. Static game visual module only; no road, engineering, accessibility, load or motion certification.
